premise.title: The Route That Might Need Closing
premise.logline: During a route-certification check, Deniz finds a beacon discrepancy large enough to justify a temporary shipping advisory—but the evidence is still too thin to know whether issuing one would protect crews or needlessly disrupt the harbor.
premise.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior licensed cartographer conducting a certification-grade field check whose report can influence real route guidance.
premise.immediate_objective: Decide what can responsibly be recorded and recommended before the tide window closes, without overstating what one field session can prove.
premise.inciting_event: A Beacon Ridge calibration falls beyond the official tolerance just before a scheduled evening freight movement, while recent harbor logs contain no accepted incident proving the route is unsafe.
premise.central_problem: Deniz must distinguish a record-worthy anomaly from evidence strong enough to justify a route advisory; acting too strongly can impose unnecessary costs, while acting too weakly can leave crews relying on a possibly wrong reference.
premise.wonder_or_discovery: A structured series suggests the discrepancy changes with the tide window, but setup, temperature, time, and the beacon itself remain competing explanations.
premise.stakes: The immediate stakes are professional and institutional: Deniz's judgment can influence pilot confidence, cargo timing, and whether senior staff trust Deniz with independent certification work.
constraints: One tide window at Beacon Ridge
A route advisory requires a higher evidence threshold than a provisional anomaly record
No current evidence proves recurrence, physical cause, or other-beacon scope
premise.meaningful_choice_pressure: Deniz must choose between spending the remaining window on a fresh independent setup that could strengthen or weaken the anomaly, or preserving the bounded evidence as a reviewed provisional record while explicitly declining to recommend route closure.
premise.mystery_or_forward_question: Is Beacon Ridge showing an isolated measurement problem, a real local drift, or the first visible edge of a wider chart-system disagreement?
premise.local_payoff: The episode must resolve what Deniz is professionally willing to put on record now, while leaving route closure, recurrence, and physical cause uncommitted unless the evidence earns them.
persistent_outcomes_possible: first_discrepancy_logged milestone becomes eligible if a reviewed provisional record is earned
Deniz's certification reviewer updates their trust in Deniz's judgment under uncertainty
A dated bounded field record becomes reusable evidence
No route advisory is committed unless the episode evidence independently earns that stronger state
world_specific_elements: harbor logistics affected by route advisories

dimensions.name: PREMISE_MATURITY
dimensions.description: Core conflict should match the target reader's autonomy and conceptual range rather than relying on vocabulary to imply maturity.

dimensions.name: NARRATIVE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support layered goals, changing information, reversals, parallel pressures, and earned resolution.

dimensions.name: CONCEPTUAL_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Allow systems, institutions, evidence, ethics, ambiguity, identity, responsibility, and competing explanations at the target level.

dimensions.name: CAUSAL_DEPTH
dimensions.description: Important outcomes should arise from several linked causes, decisions, constraints, and consequences.

dimensions.name: INFERENCE_DEMAND
dimensions.description: Allow meaningful unstated connections and interpretation without making essential causality opaque.

dimensions.name: AGENCY_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: The protagonist should make consequential strategic choices among credible alternatives.

dimensions.name: STAKES_CONSEQUENCE_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Stakes may affect reputation, relationships, livelihood, access, identity, institutions, safety, or world state without becoming melodramatic by default.

dimensions.name: SOCIAL_RELATIONSHIP_COMPLEXITY
dimensions.description: Support mixed motives, power differences, trust, conflict, loyalty, negotiation, and changing relationships without flattening people into roles.

dimensions.name: PREDICTABILITY_CHALLENGE
dimensions.description: Avoid obvious one-beat solutions; permit wrong models, reversals, incomplete information, and trade-offs.

dimensions.name: WONDER_DISCOVERY
dimensions.description: Adventure-oriented stories should still offer discovery, exploration, systems, mystery, or experiences larger than routine simulation.

dimensions.name: LANGUAGE_READABILITY
dimensions.description: Use clear, natural language appropriate to an independent adult reader; complexity should come from thought and structure, not unnecessary opacity.

required_story_capabilities: A protagonist with a credible age-appropriate role and independent agency
At least one layered objective, unresolved question, or competing priority
Multi-step causality with consequences that accumulate across the episode
A meaningful change in understanding rather than simple clue collection
A consequential choice, strategic trade-off, or irreversible local action
A local episode payoff that does not prematurely close long-horizon questions
Persistent consequence or reusable world-state value when earned
Adventure-oriented modes should include genuine discovery, exploration, mystery, or systems engagement
reject_signals: A premise made to feel older mainly through harder vocabulary
One obvious attempt solves the central problem without meaningful complication
The protagonist mostly observes while another character resolves the core problem
Exposition or lore substitutes for scene-level causality and choice
Mystery or conflict resolves by coincidence, withheld information, or unearned revelation
Violence, trauma, romance, cynicism, or darkness is added merely to signal maturity
The world could be replaced by a generic setting without materially changing the problem
language_rules: Prefer precise natural language over ornamental density
Domain-specific terminology is allowed when it serves action, reasoning, profession, or world logic and remains understandable in context
Do not use vocabulary difficulty as a substitute for premise or conceptual maturity
Let dialogue, action, evidence, and consequence carry interpretation where practical
Avoid juvenile narration unless the exact character voice or scene intentionally calls for it
safety_rules: Maturity does not require graphic violence, sexual content, trauma, or despair
Tension, danger, loss, rivalry, moral uncertainty, and difficult relationships may appear when relevant and proportionate
Do not force age stereotypes, illness, frailty, parenthood, nostalgia, or romance merely because the reader is older
calibration_notes: Age-18 stories may use adult-scale autonomy, institutions, ethical tension, identity, work/study responsibility, and ambiguous motives without assuming adult life experience.
Do not make the story feel adult merely by adding darker content or denser vocabulary.
Product session length remains separately governed by the cross-age qualification matrix.
Cross-age qualification authority: STANDARD product session is fixed at 1,600–2,500 words for the first controlled 12/18/25/40/60 proof so maturity is isolated from length.

character.name: Deniz
character.archetype: junior licensed cartographer and field surveyor
character.origin_summary: Deniz grew up in Meridian Harbor and, by eighteen, has earned junior cartographer status; the unresolved disappearance of a surveyor parent still drives a need for evidence that institutions cannot casually dismiss.
character.current_role: junior licensed cartographer under independent-route certification review

identity_anchors.statement: Deniz believes careful observation matters more than authority or bravado.
Deniz wants recognition earned through proof, not granted by rank.

core_drives.drive: Prove that rigorous observation reveals truths official maps miss.
Earn the right to chart beyond the home strait.

internal_tensions.side_b: pull toward reckless pursuit of a personally meaningful mystery
internal_tensions.description: Deniz's discipline is tested whenever a discovery brushes close to personal stakes.

immediate_desires: earn independent route-certification authority beyond the home strait
find hard evidence others cannot dismiss
immediate_avoidances: being dismissed as a reckless or overconfident junior surveyor

world.era: age of sail with precision mechanical navigation
world.habitat: a vast island chain divided by deep channels, storm belts and partially mapped outer seas
world.technology_level: sailing ships, mechanical clocks, optical instruments, printing presses and hand-built navigation devices
world.magic_level: rare, rule-bound geophysical phenomena associated with tides, magnetic stone and ancient infrastructure; no arbitrary spellcasting
world.summary: The Shattered Meridian is an archipelago civilization whose survival depends on maps. Most inner routes are well known, but outer charts disagree, old observatories stand on remote islands, drowned roads appear at extreme tides, and some navigation markers predate every living culture. The world rewards exploration, evidence and careful inference rather than effortless magic.
social_context: cartographers and navigators hold respected public roles
island councils depend on reliable sea routes
young apprentices may take meaningful expedition roles within established safety rules
merchant captains, fishers and scholars often disagree about what counts as trustworthy evidence
old folklore sometimes preserves real geographic information in distorted form
known_pressures: several navigation beacons no longer agree with official charts
outer-island routes are becoming economically important
storm season will eventually restrict long voyages
different groups have reasons to prefer different versions of the map
known_world_facts: Meridian Harbor is Deniz's home port and professional base.
Beacon Ridge is part of the known inner navigation network.
The Drowned Causeway is known to appear only during rare low tides.
The Outer Mist Line marks the edge of reliable official charts.
An abandoned tide observatory exists on a distant mapped island.
Several beacon readings have recently become difficult to reconcile with official charts, but no accepted explanation exists yet.
Temporary route advisories can delay cargo and pilot schedules, so evidence thresholds matter.

main_saga_public.title: The Uncharted Disagreement
main_saga_public.goal: Discover why the Shattered Meridian's ancient navigation infrastructure and living tides no longer agree with official charts.
main_saga_public.stakes: Outer routes vital to island trade may become unsafe or unusable if the true cause of the discrepancies goes unaddressed.
main_saga_public.central_mystery: Something in the deep channels or the ancient beacon-markers is behaving in ways no known chart-making era can explain.

eligible_main_saga_milestones.summary: Deniz notices a beacon reading that disagrees with the official chart by a margin too large for instrument error.
eligible_main_saga_milestones.state_condition: Deniz has one documented anomaly and a working hypothesis that it is not simple mistake.
consequence_options: The friend becomes curious and offers to help verify.

creation_constraints: New entities must fit low-magic, rule-bound tidal/magnetic world logic.
New NPCs should have plausible reasons to intersect Deniz's junior surveyor life.
Do not contradict established hidden truths.

episode_spine.title: The Route That Might Need Closing
episode_spine.story_promise: Deniz finds an out-of-tolerance beacon reading and must decide what a junior certifier can responsibly put on record without overstating one session's evidence.
episode_spine.protagonist_role: Eighteen-year-old junior licensed cartographer conducting a certification-grade field check whose report can influence real route guidance.
episode_spine.immediate_objective: Decide what can responsibly be recorded and recommended before the tide window closes, without overstating what one field session proves.
episode_spine.central_question: Is this a record-worthy anomaly, or evidence strong enough to justify a route advisory?
episode_spine.stakes: Deniz's judgment affects pilot confidence, cargo timing, and whether senior staff trust Deniz with independent certification work.
constraints: One tide window at Beacon Ridge
A route advisory needs a higher evidence threshold than a provisional anomaly record
No evidence proves recurrence, physical cause, or other-beacon scope
episode_spine.opening_hook: At Beacon Ridge, minutes before an evening freight movement, Deniz's calibration sight lands beyond official tolerance, and no harbor log shows an incident.

logistics_plan.time_window: Roughly 3.5 hours: a short harbor briefing, travel to the ridge, one falling-to-low tide window of about 90 minutes at Beacon Ridge, then return to Meridian Harbor before the freight movement is cleared for departure.
movement_constraints: Beacon Ridge is a single fixed-site session; no return to the ridge is possible after the window closes
Travel between the sites is a fixed transit that uses part of the budget, with no mid-window harbor trips
All harbor checks (logs, tide table) happen before departure; the reviewer is reached at the close, after return
logistics_plan.feasibility_rationale: Harbor records are gathered first, all fieldwork is done in one uninterrupted ridge window, and the reviewer meeting is held only after the return, so no beat needs simultaneous presence at both sites.

beats.purpose: Establish the certification task, the advisory threshold, and the freight deadline.
beats.character_action: Deniz reviews the tide table and recent harbor logs with the reviewer and learns the advisory versus provisional-record thresholds.
beats.external_event: The reviewer clears the ridge check on the condition that the report be filed by evening.
beats.new_information: Logs show no accepted incident on the route; an advisory needs independent, repeatable support.
beats.escalation_delta: Sets the deadline and the evidence bar.
beats.state_change: Deniz has a mandate, a clock, and a threshold to measure against.
beats.payoff_contribution: Defines what counts as record-worthy versus advisory-worthy.

beats.character_action: Deniz sets up the instrument and takes the first calibration sight against the beacon's charted bearing.
beats.external_event: The reading lands beyond official tolerance as the freight movement approaches.
beats.new_information: The offset is larger than the stated tolerance in this first reading.
beats.escalation_delta: Turns a routine check into a possible advisory question.
beats.state_change: Deniz holds an unverified anomaly under time pressure.
beats.payoff_contribution: Creates the discrepancy the episode must weigh.

beats.purpose: Test the easy explanation of instrument error.
beats.character_action: Deniz re-levels the instrument, checks the index and clock, and takes a second reading with the setup unchanged.
beats.external_event: Wind gusts and cooling air complicate the setup.
beats.new_information: The second reading still exceeds tolerance, but temperature and setup are not yet controlled.
beats.escalation_delta: The simple error explanation weakens; new confounds appear.
beats.state_change: Deniz commits to a structured series.
beats.payoff_contribution: Grounds later claims in disciplined method.

beats.character_action: Deniz takes five readings with the setup unchanged, logging clock time, tide state, and air temperature for each.
beats.external_event: The tide falls across the series and the air cools slightly.
beats.new_information: Offset falls steadily across the five readings, largest at the first and smallest at the fifth, while tide falls and temperature drops modestly.
beats.escalation_delta: The anomaly now shows structure rather than being a fixed error.
beats.state_change: Deniz has a documented, ordered series with remaining confounds.
beats.payoff_contribution: Supplies the evidence base for the reversal and both branches.

beats.purpose: Change the decision space through a stakeholder.
beats.character_action: Deniz receives a pilot's signal query asking whether the route is safe for tonight's freight.
beats.external_event: A harbor pilot asks for guidance, and the cargo agent implies delay is costly.
beats.new_information: Others will act on whatever Deniz reports, so wording matters.
beats.escalation_delta: Reputational and economic cost of overstating or understating appears.
beats.state_change: Deniz can no longer treat the data as a private exercise.

beats.purpose: Bring in the older reference and limit what it proves.
beats.character_action: Deniz compares the current bearing to the historical alignment mark on the ridge.
beats.external_event: The mark sits at a different alignment from the current charted bearing.
beats.new_information: Historically the alignment differed, but the mark cannot show when or under which tide state.
beats.escalation_delta: A second line of evidence appears but is static and weaker than it looks.
beats.state_change: Deniz has context without a tide-linked claim from it.
beats.payoff_contribution: Tests Deniz's discipline about what a static mark proves.

beats.purpose: Reinterpret the anomaly as varying rather than a fixed one-off.
beats.character_action: Deniz plots the five readings against time and tide and revisits the assumption of a fixed error.
beats.external_event: The plot shows a monotonic decline in offset as the tide falls.
beats.new_information: The offset changed systematically within this session, consistent with tide, time, temperature, or setup drift.
beats.escalation_delta: The problem shifts from whether the offset exists to what it depends on.
beats.state_change: Deniz holds a bounded pattern, not a cause.
beats.payoff_contribution: Shows the anomaly is worth recording without proving an advisory.

beats.purpose: Force a trade-off between more evidence and a secured record.
beats.character_action: Deniz weighs the remaining minutes: a fresh independent setup, or securing the bounded record.
beats.external_event: The window has time for one of the two.
beats.new_information: Both options are feasible, but neither can be done fully alongside the other.
beats.state_change: Deniz must commit to a path.

beats.purpose: Dramatize the chosen branch's fixed result.
beats.character_action: Deniz carries out the chosen branch using only the earlier series, method, and constraints.
beats.external_event: Only the branch's predefined result occurs.
beats.new_information: Branch-defined result as given in decision_point.
beats.escalation_delta: Final pressure of time and reviewer scrutiny.
beats.state_change: The evidence and record state settle per branch.

beats.purpose: Present to the reviewer and settle the record.
beats.character_action: Deniz returns and presents the findings to the reviewer, declining to recommend an advisory.
beats.external_event: The reviewer responds per branch, and the freight proceeds without an advisory.
beats.state_change: Record status and reviewer trust settle per branch.

beats.character_action: Deniz notes the unanswered scope question in the working file.
beats.external_event: A harbor clerk mentions other beacons are being cross-checked for the season.
beats.new_information: Scope beyond Beacon Ridge is untested.
beats.escalation_delta: Widens the question without answering it.
beats.payoff_contribution: Preserves the payoff while pointing ahead.

escalation_ladder: The first reading exceeds tolerance and the simple error explanation weakens.
Structured series reveals a changing offset, so a fixed error no longer fits.
A pilot and cargo agent make Deniz's wording consequential.
The historical mark adds context but cannot prove timing, forcing restraint.
The window forces an exclusive choice between more evidence and a secured record.

reversal.prior_belief: The out-of-tolerance reading was a single fixed offset or setup error.

evidence.claim: The first and second readings both exceeded tolerance.
Across five readings with an unchanged setup, offset declined in order as tide fell and air cooled slightly.
The historical mark shows an alignment difference in the past, with no timing or tide information.
The offset changed systematically within this session.

reversal.reinterpretation: The discrepancy is a varying offset within this session, so it is worth a bounded record rather than dismissal as a fixed error.
reversal.inference_ceiling: This does not establish setup-independence, physical cause, beacon causation, recurrence, other-beacon scope, or advisory-level risk; tide, time, temperature, and setup drift remain competing explanations.
reversal.unresolved_after_reversal: Whether the change is tide-driven, temperature-driven, an instrument artifact, a real beacon drift, or repeatable; whether other beacons are affected.

decision_point.pressure: The remaining window allows either a fresh independent setup or securing the record, not both.

branches.option: Spend the remaining window on a fresh independent setup.
branches.immediate_action: Deniz breaks down, re-sites, re-levels, and re-zeroes the instrument, then takes a repeat pair.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: Series plus a fresh-setup repeat pair. Fixed result: both repeat readings exceed tolerance, with offsets smaller than the series start and consistent with the series trend at that tide state.
branches.cost_or_risk: Not enough time remains to complete formal logging paperwork, so no reviewed record is filed; the freight is delayed by a late report.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: The reviewer respects the rigor but notes the missing formal entry; trust rises modestly, with no independent authority granted yet.
branches.climax_requirement: Dramatize the teardown, re-siting, and repeat pair under the closing tide, producing the fixed result; the pair survives one independent reset but does not prove setup-independence, cause, or recurrence.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: Stronger independent evidence for the anomaly, no reviewed formal log, no milestone commit, and no advisory.

branches.option: Secure the bounded evidence as a reviewed provisional record.
branches.immediate_action: Deniz stops fieldwork, documents the five-reading series with confounds, and drafts the entry declining route closure.
branches.evidence_state_after_choice: The five-reading series alone, with all confounds listed; no fresh-setup repeat exists.
branches.cost_or_risk: The anomaly stays vulnerable to a setup-error explanation, and no new evidence is gained.
branches.relationship_or_access_effect: The reviewer reads the entry and questions methodology on the missing independent repeat, yet accepts the honesty of the bounds.
branches.climax_requirement: Dramatize Deniz defending the entry's wording and limits to the reviewer, turning down the pilot's request for a closure recommendation.
branches.local_payoff_if_earned: A reviewed provisional bounded log is filed, the milestone becomes eligible, and no advisory is issued.

decision_point.what_is_unknown: Whether the offset recurs, what causes it, and whether other beacons show it.

episode_spine.climax: Under the closing tide, Deniz executes the chosen branch using only the series, method, and constraints. Fresh setup: the repeat pair exceeds tolerance and follows the trend. Provisional record: Deniz defends the bounded entry and refuses to recommend closure. Only the branch-defined result appears.
episode_spine.local_payoff: Shared: Deniz demonstrates professional judgment and declines an unsupported route advisory, so the freight proceeds without closure. Fresh_setup_repeat: stronger independent evidence but no reviewed formal record and no milestone. Provisional_record: a reviewed bounded record is filed and the milestone becomes eligible. Recurrence, cause, and scope remain uncommitted in both.
episode_spine.forward_hook: Is Beacon Ridge an isolated problem, a local drift, or the first edge of a wider chart disagreement?

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: A dated bounded field record of the five-reading series with confounds.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Committed only if the provisional_record branch is earned with the reviewed entry delivered.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: Fresh-setup repeat pair survived one independent reset.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Committed only if the fresh_setup_repeat branch is earned in delivered prose.

persistent_outcome_candidates.description: The reviewer updates trust in Deniz's judgment under uncertainty.
persistent_outcome_candidates.commit_condition: Committed only if the reviewer's branch-defined response is dramatized.
Only via the provisional_record branch with a reviewed record earned; not in fresh_setup_repeat.

completion_evidence: A documented out-of-tolerance anomaly with the five-reading series is shown.
Deniz states a working hypothesis that it is not simple mistake, with confounds named.
The reviewer accepts a bounded provisional log (provisional_record branch only).
No advisory, cause, recurrence, or scope claim is made.

anti_repetition_signature.core_problem_shape: Evidence-threshold judgment between recording and recommending action.
anti_repetition_signature.primary_activity: Structured instrument readings and professional reporting.
anti_repetition_signature.main_location_pattern: Harbor briefing, ridge fieldwork, harbor close.
anti_repetition_signature.climax_shape: Branch-specific evidence or defense under a closing window.
anti_repetition_signature.distinct_from_recent_episodes_because: No recent episodes exist; the conflict is about calibrating claims, not finding a hidden thing.

writer_rules: Do not invent evidence, reviewer verdicts, or record status beyond what the chosen branch defines.
The climax may reveal only the evidence result predefined by the chosen branch; do not invent additional unplanned evidence.
Keep the branch choice open until the decision beat; do not precommit it.
Never claim setup-independence, cause, recurrence, other-beacon scope, or advisory justification.
A static historical mark establishes only a past alignment difference.
Do not commit the milestone in prose; it is eligible only in provisional_record.
Only use meridian_harbor and beacon_ridge; mention no locked locations as scenes.
Stay within 1600-2500 words with clear natural language.

dimensions.name: AGE_MATURITY
dimensions.reason: The premise gives an eighteen-year-old credible professional autonomy, institutional responsibility, ethical ambiguity, and adult-scale consequences without relying on darker content or vocabulary.

dimensions.name: CAUSAL_COHERENCE
dimensions.reason: The beats form a clear causal chain from threshold-setting to anomaly, controlled investigation, stakeholder pressure, exclusive choice, and institutional consequence. The fresh-setup branch's late-report and freight-delay mechanics could use slightly more timing specificity.

dimensions.name: ESCALATION
dimensions.reason: Escalation changes the nature of the problem: a reading becomes a structured pattern, then a public professional decision under deadline. The historical mark and pilot pressure add distinct complications rather than merely repeating tests.

dimensions.name: AGENCY
dimensions.reason: Deniz controls the investigation and must choose between securing a usable record and obtaining stronger independent evidence. Both options have credible benefits and costs, and neither is preselected.

dimensions.name: REVERSAL_QUALITY
dimensions.reason: The reversal is properly bounded. The five ordered readings support an observed within-session change and an inferred systematic pattern, while the spine explicitly refuses unsupported claims about cause, recurrence, setup-independence, or scope.

dimensions.name: CLIMAX_PAYOFF
dimensions.reason: Both branches have distinct climax mechanics: an independent reset and repeat pair versus a defense of carefully limited wording. Each produces a different evidence and professional outcome without inventing new information.

dimensions.name: WORLD_IMMERSION
dimensions.reason: Beacon calibration, tide state, historical alignment marks, harbor logistics, route-certification thresholds, and pilot confidence materially shape the action rather than serving as decorative lore.

dimensions.name: SAGA_ALIGNMENT
dimensions.reason: The episode advances the main disagreement through an eligible first anomaly record while preserving the larger mystery. Milestone commitment is correctly conditional on the provisional-record branch.

dimensions.name: LOCAL_SATISFACTION
dimensions.reason: The episode resolves what Deniz will responsibly report and whether an advisory is justified, while leaving recurrence, cause, and wider scope open. The branch outcomes create meaningful but appropriately bounded local consequences.

dimensions.name: WRITER_EXECUTABILITY
dimensions.reason: The sequence, branch actions, evidence states, prohibited inferences, and payoff conditions are unusually well specified. Minor execution pressure remains around exact transit and reporting timing, especially the fresh-setup branch's late report and freight delay.

dimensions.name: REPETITION_SAFETY
dimensions.reason: The episode has a distinct evidence-threshold and professional-certification shape, with branch-specific climax mechanics. Its structured measurement activity could recur in the saga, but the ethical reporting choice and bounded reversal provide differentiation.

gate.decision_reason: The revised spine is mature, causally ordered, professionally consequential, and independently executable on either branch. The reversal evidence is correctly calibrated, the choice remains open, the branches produce genuinely different evidence and persistent outcomes, and the logistics plan is broadly plausible within the stated tide window. Minor timing details may be staged by the writer but do not require inventing the episode's core logic.
